digest.component_or_area: blocking-link resolver in the hierarchy dependency graph
propositions: The blocking-link resolver decided comparability from a ticket's type tier instead of its position in the parent hierarchy, silently recording a different edge than requested.
A ticket could end up with a blocking edge against its own ancestor or descendant, distorting ready, next-batch and the parent-first claim cascade.
Comparability must be decided structurally via nearest common ancestor so that any two tickets sharing a parent may hold a direct dependency.
No blocking edge may exist between a ticket and its own ancestor or descendant by any path into the resolver.
Blocking edges written under the old type-tier rule must be detectable store-wide and repairable in a single pass via a rebar doctor check.
Cross-subtree links must still auto-escalate and emit the existing machine-readable redirect record unchanged for callers.
